incidents.name: Warp Finance LP collateral valuation manipulation
incidents.notes: WarpControl valued deposited Uniswap V2 LP collateral from the pair's live spot reserves, so a flash-loaned swap that doubled the WETH-DAI LP price let the attacker borrow 3.86m DAI and 3.9m USDC against collateral worth a fraction of that; the lending code itself behaved as written.

sources.ref: onchain review: resolved the victim from the attack tx logs - 0xba539b9a is the verified WarpControl (the borrow authoriser and collateral valuer); the WarpVaultSC lenders 0x6046c3ab/0xae465fd3/0xdadd9ba3 and WarpVaultLP 0x13db1cb4 also appear. Created 2020-12-16 by 0x8f3e8a974d6eb27316054147fdf0e960dab2e1b3, not by attack sender 0xebc6bd6a - only 1.7 days before the incident, matching Warp's 2020-12-09 launch. lossUsd is the borrowed 3.86m DAI + 3.9m USDC, both USD-pegged 1:1
